timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In the vast expanse of space, there is a floating cloud of alcohol? Yes, you heard it right.
Astronomers have discovered a massive alcohol cloud in the Milky Way, spanning over 463 billion kilometers.
This cloud contains a staggering amount of alcohol, equivalent to 400 trillion trillion pints of beer.
So, the next time you look up at the stars, raise a glass to the cosmic booze floating out there in space.
